0022600205.text: The Washington Wizards (4-6, 8th in the East) visit the Detroit Pistons (6-3, 1st in the Central, 3rd in the East) as the Wizards try to snap a three-game losing streak, having gone 2-4 on the road. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and the teams have not met yet this season. Last season the Wizards lost the series 1-3, including a 117-95 loss in Washington on March 19, 2026.
